example_sentences_in_bangla: সে ভয়ে নট নড়ন-চড়ন করে দাঁড়িয়ে রইল।
ঘরের ভিতর নট নড়ন-চড়ন, সবাই অচল।
example_sentences_in_english: He stood frozen in fear, not a single movement.
The room was still, with no one budging an inch.
note: This idiom emphasizes complete immobility, often used in contexts of fear or strict restraint in Bengali folklore and daily speech.
